# koko — Text-to-Speech CLI for AI Agents

> High-performance, zero-dependency C++ ONNX neural Text-to-Speech CLI for macOS (~0.4s response time).

## System Capability & Agent Setup

AI agents (OpenCode, Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Aider) can use `koko` to speak updates, status reports, and casual responses back to the user.

### Installation
```bash
brew install 4nkitd/tap/koko
```
*Or via Go:*
```bash
go install github.com/4nkitd/koko@latest
```

### Agent Spoken Protocol

Whenever confirming task completion, asking casual questions, or presenting strategic updates, execute:

```bash
koko [flags] "CONCISE_RESPONSE_TEXT"
```

### Character Voice Flags
- `koko --ironman "text"` : Iron Man / Tony Stark voice (Default)
- `koko --friday "text"`  : F.R.I.D.A.Y. tactical AI assistant voice
- `koko --jarvis "text"`  : J.A.R.V.I.S. AI assistant voice
- `koko -f "text"`        : Enable Audio Focus (ducks system background audio during playback)

### Speed & Performance
- Standard execution: **~0.4s**
- Background daemon mode (`koko daemon`): **<30ms IPC**
